title: gufo backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the gufo provider (Phase 12). x-flag names the exact `gufo serve llm` CLI flag; command.py remains the executable mapping. None-skip semantics hold: a null or absent value is never emitted and gufo keeps its own default. bool-only flags (verbose / log_progress) emit only when true. Aux spec files (mmproj / dflash_model / dspark_model / mtp_model) live in `artifacts` and are resolved by the driver to local paths before spawn.

artifacts.title: Model files
artifacts.description: Main model and auxiliary spec/vision files resolved through provider_lib.downloader before spawn; each resolved path is rewritten into the corresponding CLI flag value.

model.title: Main model
model.description: Primary GGUF model file (hf-file descriptor or local path). Passed as `--model <resolved path>`.

mmproj.title: Vision projector
mmproj.description: mmproj file for multimodal models; descriptor resolved to a local path and passed as `--mmproj`.

dflash_model.title: DFLASH draft model
dflash_model.description: Draft model for dflash speculative decoding; descriptor resolved to a local path and passed as `--dflash-model`.

dspark_model.title: DSPARK draft model
dspark_model.description: Draft model for dspark speculative decoding; descriptor resolved to a local path and passed as `--dspark-model`.

mtp_model.title: MTP model
mtp_model.description: Multi-token-prediction model; descriptor resolved to a local path and passed as `--mtp-model`.

context.title: Context size
context.description: Prompt context window in tokens. null/absent = gufo default.

served_model_name.title: Served model name
served_model_name.description: Model name advertised on /v1/models (gufo otherwise advertises the GGUF filename). null/absent = derived.

cache_disk.title: Disk cache enabled
cache_disk.description: When true, a per-instance directory <CACHE_DIR>/<instance_id> is created and passed via `--cache-disk`. instance_id is the REAL admin-issued registration id (the driver falls back to MACHINE_UID only if the backend starts before registration), so two gufo definitions on one machine never share a disk-cache directory. Anything other than true omits the flag.

cache_disk_bytes.title: Disk cache size (bytes)
cache_disk_bytes.description: On-disk cache size cap in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

cache_disk_staging_bytes.title: Disk cache staging (bytes)
cache_disk_staging_bytes.description: Staging buffer budget for disk cache writes in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

speculative.title: Speculative Decoding
speculative.description: Draft proposals only; accepted tokens are verified by the target model, so outputs stay bitwise-identical. The draft model files themselves are artifacts (dflash_model / dspark_model / mtp_model).

speculative.title: Speculative mode
speculative.description: Speculative decoding mode selector (e.g. 'dflash2'). null/absent = gufo default.

draft_policy.title: Draft policy
draft_policy.description: Draft selection policy (e.g. 'adaptive'). null/absent = gufo default.

draft_tokens.title: Draft tokens
draft_tokens.description: Tokens drafted per step. null/absent = gufo default.

min_draft_tokens.title: Min draft tokens
min_draft_tokens.description: Minimum tokens to attempt per draft step. null/absent = gufo default.

sampling.title: Sampling Defaults
sampling.description: Server-side default sampling parameters (requests may override). These change output numerics.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Default sampling temperature. null/absent = gufo default.

top_k.title: Top-k
top_k.description: Top-k sampling cutoff. null/absent = gufo default.

top_p.title: Top-p
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability. null/absent = gufo default.

min_p.title: Min-p
min_p.description: Minimum probability cutoff relative to the top token. null/absent = gufo default.

min_keep.title: Min keep
min_keep.description: Minimum tokens kept by truncating samplers. null/absent = gufo default.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Default RNG seed. null/absent = gufo default.

repeat_penalty.title: Repeat penalty
repeat_penalty.description: Repetition penalty scale (1.0 = disabled). null/absent = gufo default.

repeat_last_n.title: Repeat last n
repeat_last_n.description: Look-back window for the repetition penalty. null/absent = gufo default.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Frequency penalty scale. null/absent = gufo default.

presence_penalty.title: Presence penalty
presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty scale. null/absent = gufo default.

max_tokens.title: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: Default generation length cap. null/absent = gufo default.

reasoning.title: Reasoning / Thinking
reasoning.description: Server-side reasoning defaults. Changes emitted content.

think.title: Think
think.description: Tri-state thinking switch passed verbatim (e.g. 'on' / 'off' / 'auto'). null/absent = gufo default.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Named effort level for reasoning models (e.g. 'high'). null/absent = gufo default.

preserve_thinking.title: Preserve thinking
preserve_thinking.description: Keep reasoning content across turns (value passed verbatim). null/absent = gufo default.

limits.title: Scheduling & Protection Limits
limits.description: Server-protection and scheduling limits (policy only; no output numerics effect).

prefill_chunk.title: Prefill chunk
prefill_chunk.description: Tokens per prefill chunk. null/absent = gufo default.

max_pending.title: Max pending requests
max_pending.description: Global pending-request queue cap. null/absent = gufo default.

max_pending_per_client.title: Max pending per client
max_pending_per_client.description: Per-client pending-request cap. null/absent = gufo default.

request_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Server-side request timeout in milliseconds. null/absent = gufo default.

max_output_bytes.title: Max output bytes
max_output_bytes.description: Cap on per-request output size in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

max_buffered_output_bytes.title: Max buffered output bytes
max_buffered_output_bytes.description: Per-stream buffered output cap in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

max_buffered_output_total.title: Max buffered output total (bytes)
max_buffered_output_total.description: Global buffered output cap in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

sessions.title: GPU sessions
sessions.description: Preallocated GPU sessions = engine request concurrency. The driver reports this as effective_capacity.

max_connections.title: Max connections
max_connections.description: Inbound connection cap. null/absent = gufo default.

max_request_bytes.title: Max request bytes
max_request_bytes.description: Inbound request size cap in bytes. null/absent = gufo default.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Shared secret required on inbound gufo requests. null/absent = no auth.

verbose.title: Verbose logging
verbose.description: Bool-only flag: `--verbose` is emitted only when true; false/None omitted so gufo keeps its default.

log_progress.title: Log progress
log_progress.description: Bool-only flag: `--log-progress` is emitted only when true; false/None omitted so gufo keeps its default.
